snippet.title: Haunted Vlogs FULL Game Walkthrough / Playthrough - Let's Play (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Haunted Vlogs By Romaniachan Normal Ending One and Normal Ending Two Horror RPG Maker Game Part 1 to Ending [Microsoft Windows]

Two teenagers, a vlogger and her cameraman go to explore an abandoned college, searching for clues and eventually an exit. There is a small tension between them, will they tell their feelings before it's too late?

Haunted Vlogs: https://romaniachan.itch.io/haunted-vlogs
Developer: Romaniachan
Genres: Puzzle, RPG, Horror
Platforms: Microsoft Windows
